definitions.explanation: The quality of being accurate, exact, or free from error. The nominalized form of the na-adjective 正確, used when referring to accuracy as an abstract quality or measurable attribute.

examples.japanese: {正確|せいかく}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{正確|せいかく}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{定評|ていひょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This watch has a strong reputation for accuracy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{翻訳|ほんやく}→翻訳：01725_honyaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{正確|せいかく}さ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}さ→自然さ：22578_shizensa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: In translation, balancing accuracy and naturalness is difficult.

notes:
Formed by adding the suffix さ to the na-adjective ⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧ (accurate, precise), turning it into a noun that refers to the quality or degree of accuracy itself.

USAGE:
Used when discussing accuracy as a measurable quality or standard — in contexts like manufacturing, translation, scientific measurement, sports, and timekeeping. While ⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧ (na-adjective) describes something as accurate, {正確|せいかく}さ (noun) refers to the concept of accuracy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正確|せいかく}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧ — to demand accuracy
- {正確|せいかく}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧ — to lack accuracy
- {正確|せいかく}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}する→重視する：26832_juushisuru⟧ — to value accuracy
- ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧{正確|せいかく}さ — high accuracy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{精度|せいど}→精度：13787_seido⟧ — precision, degree of accuracy; more technical, used in engineering and science
- ⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧ — accurate (na-adjective); the base adjective form
- ⟦{的確|てきかく}→的確：04536_tekikaku⟧さ — aptness, being on-target; emphasizes hitting the right point rather than exactness
